entries.question: Mai apptment lena chahta hu
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), online registration is mandatory. You can use any of the following methods:

1. **Online (ORS Portal):** Visit the official portal at [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the required department and date, fill in your patient details, and pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee to download your appointment slip.
2. **Mobile App:** Use the ABHA or official Healthcare mobile apps to register with your mobile number and follow the same booking steps.
3. **SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to complete the OTP verification, collect a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee at the counter, and get your OPD slip (pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times).

**Important OPD Details:**
- **Timings:** Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Closed on Sundays and gazetted holidays.
- **Helpline Numbers:** 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333.
- **Note:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral letter for the specific department.

entries.answer:
I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.

For scheduling an MRI scan (such as for the spine) at KGMU:
1. **Consultation:** Visit the relevant OPD (such as Neurology, Neurosurgery, or Orthopedics) to get an official prescription/recommendation for the MRI.
2. **OPD Registration:** Online registration is mandatory via the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in) or by calling the helpline (0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333). OPD slip fee is ₹50.

entries.question: Semen analysis jach karani hai
entries.answer:

Pehle aapko OPD mein doctor ko dikhana hoga:
- Online registration zaroori hai. Aap [ORS Portal](https://ors.gov.in) ya ABHA app ke zariye appointment le sakte hain.
- OPD slip ki fee ₹50 hai.
- OPD ka samay: Somvaar se Shukrawar (Mon–Fri) subah 9:00 AM se dopahar 1:00 PM tak aur Shanivar ko subah 9:00 AM se 12:00 PM tak (Ravivar ko OPD band rehti hai).

KGMU rate list ke anusaar, pathology ya lab tests ki fees ₹15 se lekar ₹4,000 tak ho sakti hain. Exact test aur charges ki jankari ke liye aap relevant department ya counter par pata kar sakte hain.

*Note: Main medical advice nahi de sakta, isliye behter hoga ki aap KGMU OPD ke doctor se mil kar hi sahi salah aur test ki process ki jankari lein.*

entries.question: Ji appointment kaise le

entries.question: What is geriatic mental health
entries.answer:

1. **Online (Anivarya/Mandatory):** Aap [ORS Portal (Online Registration System)](https://ors.gov.in) ya ABHA/Health Care App ke zariye ghar baithe appointment le sakte hain. Iske liye aapko apna rajya (Uttar Pradesh) aur hospital (KGMU) chun kar department aur date select karni hogi.
2. **SMS ke zariye:** Aap `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likh kar **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain.

**Zaroori Baatein:**

entries.question: Appointment opd
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), online registration is mandatory. Here are the available booking methods:

1. **Online (ORS):** Visit [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, pick your department and date, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee, and download the slip.
2. **Mobile App:** Use the ABHA or appropriate Healthcare mobile app following the same hospital selection flow.
3. **SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Bring your Aadhaar number and an active mobile number to complete OTP verification, obtain a physical token, pay the ₹50 slip fee, and collect your OPD slip at the counter.

**Important Guidelines:**
- **Timings:** Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Closed on Sundays.
- **Counter Closing:** The ticket/parchi counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
- **Referral:** Outside-city patients must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
- Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times. 

For further assistance, you can contact the KGMU Helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: Opd book karni hai
entries.answer:
KGMU में OPD बुकिंग के लिए ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप नीचे दिए गए तरीकों में से किसी एक का उपयोग करके बुकिंग कर सकते हैं:

1. **ORS पोर्टल (Online Registration System):** [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाएं, राज्य (Uttar Pradesh) और अस्पताल (KGMU) का चयन करें, विभाग और तारीख चुनकर अपनी जानकारी भरें और ₹50 का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करके पर्ची डाउनलोड करें।
2. **आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल मिशन (ABHA) ऐप:** ऐप पर मोबाइल नंबर और ओटीपी के जरिए रजिस्टर करें और समान प्रक्रिया का पालन करें।
3. **SMS द्वारा:** `Appointment [Patient Name]` लिखकर `8887019134` पर भेजें।
4. **वॉक-इन (अस्पताल आकर):** अपना आधार कार्ड और चालू मोबाइल नंबर साथ लेकर आएं। काउंटर पर ओटीपी सत्यापित कर ₹50 का भुगतान करके फिजिकल टोकन व OPD पर्ची प्राप्त करें।

**महत्वपूर्ण बातें:**
- OPD पर्ची का शुल्क ₹50 है।
- समय: सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक, शनिवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक (रविवार बंद)।
- लखनऊ से बाहर के मरीजों के लिए संबंधित विभाग का वैध रेफरल लाना अनिवार्य है। 

अस्पताल आने से पहले ऑनलाइन बुकिंग करने की सलाह दी जाती है ताकि लंबी कतारों से बचा जा सके।
